description: Ministry of Justice - Order under Transfer of Offenders Act, No. 05 of 1995. applying to Islamic Republic of Iran
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an Order made under Section 2 of the Transfer of Offenders Act, No. 5 of 1995. While it mentions Minister Thalatha Athukorale by name, it does not describe her detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond her title "Minister of Justice." The core content is about extending the application of a specific law to the Islamic Republic of Iran, which falls under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
